_doc: Shims and open items for the QNFO cutover (was docs/cutover/SHIMS.md). Shims live in the QNFO instance overlay, never in shared code. Each has an exit and a closing probe; tests/test_cutover_shims.py checks the shape. Source for open items: issue #93.

shims.dependency: Secret lease shared by every agent lane (deploy-guard)
shims.why_no_generic_equivalent: core/claims covers work claims; the lease needs a live secret store
shims.shim: Overlay route to the old lease endpoint, behind the route table
shims.exit: Generic lease over Workers secrets bindings
shims.closing_probe: no calls to the old endpoint for 7 days

shims.dependency: QNFO model ladder and provider keys
shims.why_no_generic_equivalent: Ladder is data; keys are the owner's
shims.shim: Instance file model_ladder plus binding names

shims.dependency: Charter, portfolio and research-specific tick steps
shims.shim: Overlay steps registered into the generic tick
Overlay scorers on the core/observe port

shims.why_no_generic_equivalent: not extracted; console is the generic surface
shims.shim: Keep the old page serving until console login covers it
shims.closing_probe: route has zero hits for 7 days

shims.shim: Redirect old dashboard host to the new console

shims.dependency: The 12 app workers and 8 personal workers
shims.shim: Keep in QNFO deployment; reach core over HTTP routes only

open_items.item: Server-side ops agent that drives core/deploy
open_items.workaround: Old ops worker serves deploys until it is; stage 5 for this unit waits
open_items.closing_probe: agent opens a deploy item and the change path runs it in a test

open_items.blocker: needs QNFO sources or a live account

open_items.item: Durable Object wrapper for the agents runtime
